content_html_sanitized:
The White House has said that the President has not decided whether to reschedule marijuana from Schedule 1, which says it has no medical use, to Schedule 3.

 

That would mean that doctors could prescribe it. For example it would allow doctors at Veterans Administration hospitals to prescribe it to disabled veterans with chronic pain problems.

See

Veterans Who Fought for Our Freedom May Finally Get Medical Cannabis

And

The Wall Street Journal Carries Excellent Story About The Outrageous Medical Abuse of Veterans: But No Mention of Medical Cannabis

And links

 

President Trump likes to create suspense about his possible actions, so he has given mixed signals.

See

Former NFL Star, Ricky Williams, Has Been Fighting For Medical Marijuana For Over Twenty Years. Meets With Trump Officials At White House.

And

The Complicated Politics of Trump’s Medical Cannabis Policies

 

It’s clear why President Trump wants to loosen up the restrictions on medical cannabis.

See 9 In 10 Americans Support Legalizing Marijuana In Some Form, Including Bipartisan Majorities, Pew Poll Shows.

But not everyone:

Kevin Sabet has issued a statement on X, saying, “Rumor has it Trump wants to down schedule weed. This would make him the most pro drug president in modern American history. Don’t do it, Donald.”

 

From someone on X: “Cannabis is medicine. Kevin is a shill for big pharma and big alcohol. Where does his funding come from?”

To which Sabet responded, “I’ve never taken a penny from big Pharma - but if you keep saying that my lawyer will want your address.”

 

From Kevin Sabet’s Decades Long War Against Medical Cannabis:

“The drug has the opposite effect from what its advocates and industry pushers claim.”

And

“Raw weed isn’t medicine. Getting the government and insurance companies to suggest otherwise will only get more people hooked, ruin more lives and wreck public health while fattening the wallets of addiction profiteers.”

 

His motives are not to be questioned, but people who disagree with him or the Hungarian regime are “pushers” or “addiction profiteers.” See Kevin Sabet Praises Hungary’s Zero Tolerance For Cannabis: Public demonstrations for cannabis outlawed”
